title: Chapter 124: Possible Red Specter
html:
An hour later, the middle-aged man returned to Hai Ming Apartments with Xiao Du. A bandage wrapped the young man’s head, and his gaze remained unfocused.

“You’re finally back.” Chen Ge emerged from Room 304, still holding the mallet. “Relax. I’m not going to hurt you. I only want to ask a few questions.”

The young man’s eyes darted about evasively before opening the door to his room. “Come in then.”

A heavy stench filled Room 302. Even the middle-aged man, whose own apartment was hardly clean, covered his nose. “When did you last clean this place? Did some food rot?”

Chen Ge frowned. The room itself was tidy, and Xiao Du took care of his appearance. He did not seem like a slob.

“The past two months feel like a dream.” Holding his head, Xiao Du crossed to the bed and pulled a black plastic bag from underneath. It was filled with small animal carcasses. “A nightmare I couldn’t wake from.”

Chen Ge glanced into the bag before his gaze fell back on the young man. “Now that your nightmare is over, you can tell us the things that you’ve been hiding.”

Xiao Du set the bag aside and began with an apology. “When I moved in three months ago, the landlady said I could leave without penalty if I felt uncomfortable or encountered anything strange. On my first night, I dreamed that the window was leaking. When I went to close it, I saw a man standing in the apartment next door.

“At first, I ignored it. After the dream repeated several times, I realized the man from the neighboring room had entered mine. I tried to resist, but I couldn’t move. He didn’t hurt me, though. He said he only needed my help.

“The next morning, I couldn’t concentrate on anything. I spent the following night at a friend’s place, but the man had attached himself to me. This time, he appeared beside the bed.

“He said I could never escape him, but promised to leave me alone if I helped. I believed him. At his command, I caught small animals and threw them into Room 303 alive. Every time I checked the next morning, they were dead.

“There were no wounds, so I had no idea what killed them.” Xiao Du grew more frightened as he continued. “I wanted to escape, but his appetite kept growing. First he asked for sparrows and rats. A week later, he demanded stray dogs. The last time, he ordered me to lure a living person into Room 303 after midnight.

“When I refused, he threatened to kill me in my dreams. I had nowhere left to turn.”

Eyes reddening, Xiao Du lowered his head. “I told my friends, and several of us entered Room 303 late one night. Nothing happened, so they stopped believing me and decided I’d lost my mind.

“I had no one else to ask for help, and the man’s presence kept growing stronger. Even during the day, I could feel him standing beside me, watching.”

Xiao Du gripped the bandage around his head. “By then, I only wanted to be rid of him. I tried to lure someone into Room 303, but I couldn’t manage it.”

After collecting himself, he continued. “A few days later, I saw Men Nan’s housing ad at school. You can guess the rest. He didn’t want to live in the dormitory, and his budget was limited, so I recommended Hai Ming Apartments.”

“So you’re the reason Men Nan moved into Room 304?” Chen Ge had not expected that.

“I warned him that the place might be dangerous, but like me, he dismissed it.” Unburdening himself seemed to bring Xiao Du some relief.

“That’s in the past, so we won’t press charges, though the final decision belongs to Men Nan once he wakes.” Chen Ge took out the rusted key. “Now answer a few questions honestly. If you don’t know, say so. Don’t invent anything.”

“Okay.”

“Have you ever seen the man’s face in your dream?”

“Once,” Xiao Du admitted after a long hesitation. “He has two faces, like two people sewn together. They talk and argue with each other.”

“Besides issuing demands, did they discuss anything else?” This was a rare chance to learn about the world behind the mirrors.

“Mostly, they argued. Once, one face shouted that if he weren’t afraid of the Red Specter, he would rather die than share a body with trash.”

“Red Specter?” The familiar term made Chen Ge frown. He opened the black phone’s affection page. Xiaoxiao was classified as a Baleful Specter, while Zhang Ya was specifically labeled a Red Specter.

The distinction might seem minor, but those two words had earned Zhang Ya a page of her own on the black phone. The creature Wang Haiming brought from the Third Sick Hall knew about a Red Specter, which meant one might reside there.

A specter on Zhang Ya’s level.The thought made Chen Ge’s head ache. The first mirror monster he encountered had been little more than a toy to Zhang Ya; an ordinary ghost was powerless before a Red Specter. Sighing, he motioned for Xiao Du to continue.

“I also discovered several weaknesses and planned to use them if things became desperate.” Xiao Du sat on the bed, apparently oblivious to the bag’s stench. “The monster rarely appeared except around midnight. It feared light and noise, and strangest of all, it seemed afraid of cats.”

“Afraid of cats?” Chen Ge was curious.

“Yes. The man demanded all kinds of living animals, but never cats. I think he fears them.” The reasoning was plausible but still speculative, and Chen Ge had no desire to test it personally. Perhaps I can devise a safe experiment at the Haunted House.

When Chen Ge fell silent, Xiao Du dared not continue. The middle-aged man listening nearby, however, stared at them with eyes as round as the moon.
